tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search products and services offered by local businesses in Austria (mainly Vienna and Lower Austria) listed on fixfind.at. Listings are in German, so use German search terms (e.g. "Möbelmontage", "Fotograf", "Felgenreparatur"). Filter by location (Austrian postal code like "1100", a prefix like "23

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Get full details of one offer by its id (from search_offers): complete description, price, address, provider website and phone (if the provider published it), images and the offer page url, where the user can contact the provider.

tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: Overview of what fixfind.at offers: all categories with the number of offers, and the towns with the most offers. Useful before searching, to pick a category or location.

description: Search products that can be bought online from Austrian businesses using fixfind Shop (shops embedded in the merchants' own websites: farm shops, food, crafts, garden, pet supplies ...). labels.name: get_product
labels.description: Get full details of one shop product by its id (from search_products): description, variants with prices and stock, shipping zones and costs, delivery time, accepted payment methods, pickup option, and the url where the user can buy it in the merchant's shop.
